full_prompt_en: The image is a square soft pastel portrait of a young woman with powdered curls and pale flowers against a dark green background. She is shown from the shoulders upward, body turned to the right while her head turns back toward the viewer. Her gaze is gentle and slightly lowered, and the pale face is modeled with ivory, peach, and soft rose tones. The cheek carries a light pink blush, while the small mouth has a restrained rosy red. High arranged curls form a cloud of silvery blond hair around the head. A pale blue ribbon crosses the hair near the top, interwoven with tiny white blossoms, green leaves, and a larger pink rose beside the right temple. Below, a white lace collar rises around the neck and disappears into a muted blue-green garment at the lower right. A small floral detail sits near the chest. The background is nearly black along the left edge and upper corners, opening to smoky olive and blue-green behind the right side of the head. There is no furniture or setting detail, so attention stays on the luminous face and elaborate soft textures. The close viewpoint is level with her eyes, and her shoulder angle gives the portrait a slight diagonal movement. Diffuse light from the upper left brightens the forehead, nose, cheek, lace, and pale petals; the back of the hair and garment fade into shadow. Pastel-like pigment creates powdery, feathered transitions in skin and hair, with finer touches reserved for eyes, lips, and flowers. The composition feels intimate and poised, balancing the bright warm oval and cool blue fabric against a deep velvety field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形柔和粉彩肖像：一位戴浅花饰、留着粉白卷发的年轻女子立在深绿背景前。画面从肩以上描她，身体朝右，头回转向观者。目光温柔并略微低垂，浅脸由象牙、桃与柔玫瑰色塑形。脸颊有轻浅粉红，嘴唇小且呈收敛的玫瑰红。高高盘起的卷发在头周围形成一团银金色云。浅蓝丝带横过头顶部的头发，与小白花、绿叶和右侧太阳穴旁较大的粉玫瑰编在一起。下方，白蕾丝领在颈旁升起，消入右下低饱和蓝绿色衣装；胸附近另有一点花饰。背景在左画边和上角近乎全黑，在头右后方打开成烟状橄榄与蓝绿色。没有家具或场景细节，注意力因此留在明亮面孔和繁复柔软纹理上。贴近的视点与她的眼平齐，肩部角度给肖像一点斜向运动。漫散光从左上照亮前额、鼻、脸颊、蕾丝和浅花瓣；后侧头发与衣服淡入阴影。粉彩般颜料在皮肤和头发里形成粉末状、羽化的过渡，眼、唇与花则留更细点笔。构图亲密而端庄，以明亮暖色椭圆和冷蓝衣料对着深绒状底场。
style_prompt_en: Powdery pastel painting blends warm ivory, peach, and blush into a luminous soft oval against deep olive-black and smoky blue-green. Feathery edges allow pale forms to emerge gradually from a velvety dark field. Small cool-blue ribbons of color and tiny cream-pink accents interrupt the muted range without breaking its calm. Diffuse upper light creates gentle rounded modeling and leaves the lower and rear areas in colored shadow. Fine dry pigment grain is visible through smooth transitions, with only a few crisp details at the focal point. The crop is close, the background spare, and the overall rhythm quiet and poised. Material softness and light-dark separation carry the image more than hard contour.
style_prompt_zh: 粉末感粉彩画把暖象牙、桃与浅粉融成发亮的柔和椭圆，对着深橄榄黑与烟状蓝绿。羽化边缘使浅色形体从绒状暗场里逐渐浮出。少量冷蓝色带和细小奶油粉点缀打断低饱和范围，又不破坏平静。上方漫散光形成温和圆润的塑形，后方和下方留在有色阴影中。细干颜料颗粒从平滑过渡中可见，只有焦点处少数细节清脆。裁幅贴近，背景简省，整体节奏安静端庄。材料柔度与明暗分隔比坚硬轮廓更能承载图像。
theme_en: A young woman with powdered curls and pale flowers against dark green
theme_zh: 一位戴浅色花饰、留着粉白卷发的年轻女子立在深绿背景前
name: Rosalba Carriera
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
